Song tempo (BPM) data

Source: R/data.R
song_tempo_bpm_data.Rd

Song tempo (BPM) data

Usage

song_tempo_bpm_data

Format

dataframe with one row for each song with a personally-measured tempo reading.

title

The name of the song

tempo_bpm

Tempo, in beats per minute, measured personally by Alex Mitrani

Provenance

Raw-hand-curated, from inst/extdata/song_tempo_bpm_data.csv. Read as-is by Repeatr_1, no transformation. Not exported to fugazibase - kept in Repeatr only, for its own Shiny app.

song_tempo_bpm_data
